title: Baguette Pro: Apple-keynote parody product film
summary: A pitch-perfect Apple product-page parody: a single baguette floats on an off-white canvas while short bold statements ('Baguette Pro.', 'Crust. Reimagined.', '65 cm.', 'Up to 24 hours of freshness.', 'Zero ports. One butter.') rise in one at a time. One full-bleed macro crust shot breaks the rhythm; it ends on product + 'From €1.20.' price card. Calm, confident, extremely restrained.
fit_reason: The Apple statement grammar (one hero object, one short line, accent second line, lots of white space) maps directly onto feature-by-feature SaaS launches and carousels with zero hype.

palette.mood: light airy, Apple-white, one warm gold accent

typography.display: SF Pro Display Bold / Inter Bold, tight tracking
typography.case: sentence, each statement ends with a full stop
typography.size_behaviour: large title top-centre (~6% frame height) above hero object; two-line pairs where line 1 is near-black and line 2 is gold accent; tiny grey footnotes ('(realistically, 6)', 'The longest display we have ever baked.')
typography.notes: Parody copy uses spec-sheet style: number + unit ('65 cm.'), benefit + qualifier. Footnote jokes in ~1.5% height grey.

text_animation: line rises from below a mask with slight blur, ~0.4 s ease-out
second (accent) line follows 0.2-0.3 s later with same rise
outgoing text slides up and out above mask
dimension line draws out left/right under the object for '65 cm.'
motion: hero object slow scale/drift (push-in) with soft drop shadow
object shrinks into a battery-icon frame for freshness gag
image card slides in left of text
subtle parallax between object and text
transitions: vertical push (text and object move up together)
hard cut to full-bleed macro photo and back
graphic_elements: hero product cutout with soft contact shadow
thin gold dimension line with end ticks
ui_treatment: none (the product object stands in for a device); would map to a floating UI screenshot
signature_moves: one hero object + one short statement per beat on pure off-white
spec-sheet number lines with a drawn dimension rule
price/CTA end card 'From €1.20.' with tiny footnote

best_segments.what: 'Introducing' -> 'Baguette Pro.' title rises over floating hero object
'Crust. Reimagined.' two-tone line then '65 cm.' with dimension line drawing out
'Zero ports. One butter.' card + 'Designed in Paris. Baked every morning.' mask-rise transition

recreate.how: HTML+GSAP or Remotion: off-white canvas, PNG/screenshot hero with drop shadow, SF/Inter Bold lines in overflow:hidden wrappers animated y:100%->0 with blur 6px->0, gold accent span, SVG line draw for dimension rule.
recreate.prompt: Apple-style product film on off-white #F7FAF9: one floating hero object, short bold sentence-case statements rising from a mask one at a time, second line in warm gold #B17F2A, tiny grey footnotes, a dimension line drawing out, price end card.
